objectives.description: Create dispatch-worktree.sh with strict-mode preamble and --help
Implement provision: free-space + cap preflight, worktree add, hardlink-clone .claude//.lake, PROJECT_ROOT assertion, registry record, JSON verdict, idempotent reuse
Implement path: resolve most recent registry record, distinct not-found exit
Implement release: strip untracked .claude//.lake scratch first, git worktree remove, delete record, keep branch
Implement prune: age-based staleness, spare calling session unconditionally
Register .orchestrate-worktrees/ and specs/.worktree-registry/ in orchestrator-runtime-files.md and .gitignore
Write test-dispatch-worktree.sh covering all required cases plus a bonus worktree-cap case
chmod +x both new scripts; register both in core/manifest.json provides.scripts so deploy actually ships them

approaches_tried.approach: test fixture committing .claude/ into the scratch repo's git history so build_repo could seed deployed scripts
approaches_tried.reason: made git worktree add check out .claude/ already, so the script's own cp -al hardlink-clone step nested a copy inside it instead of populating a clean destination -- diverges from the real system where .claude/ is always gitignored/untracked (Phase 1's confirmed fact). Fixed by leaving .claude/ untracked in the fixture, matching production.

deviations.description: Register dispatch-worktree.sh and tests/test-dispatch-worktree.sh in agent-system/extensions/core/manifest.json's provides.scripts array
deviations.reason: Not named in the plan's own Files to modify list for this phase, but discovered load-bearing during verification: deploy-headless.sh only ships files explicitly listed in provides.scripts, so the first deploy silently produced a .claude/ tree missing dispatch-worktree.sh entirely despite RESULT=landed. Without this addition the acceptance criterion (deployed script present and --help-responsive) is unreachable.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- manifest.json registration added, not originally listed as a file to modify)*
